---
name: Data or documentation issue
about: Report a specific record, rule, archive, or documentation problem
title: "[Data issue] "
labels: [data-quality]
---

Please include the dataset subset, source record ID (or DisasterM3 category and `_original_index`), variant key (`raw` or `t1`–`t7`), and candidate version. Describe the expected and observed interpretation, including the answer or option affected. For a semantic-equivalence concern, identify the changed referent, time, quantity, polarity, task instruction, or answer condition.

Do not post credentials, private local paths, or source images/masks unless their redistribution is permitted. A report does not itself change the dataset; corrections require a documented review decision and a new version.
